title: Rewrite in plain words
prompt: Rewrite [piece] for [audience] in plain words. Keep the facts. Do not add claims.
popularity_note: A short rewrite people start from.

title: Short email
prompt: Write an email to [name] about [topic]. Keep it under [length]. This is a draft. Do not send it.
popularity_note: Starts a draft. Nothing is sent.

title: Ad from the facts
prompt: Write an ad for [offer] aimed at [customer]. Use only these facts: [facts]. No made-up results.
popularity_note: Keeps the ad tied to facts you supply.

title: One social post
prompt: Write one [platform] post about [topic] for [audience]. Offer a draft only.
popularity_note: One post. Nothing is published.

title: Follow-up draft
prompt: Write a follow-up to [name] about [offer]. This is a draft. Do not send it.
popularity_note: A follow-up you can edit.

title: Explain this code
prompt: Explain [code] in plain words, then suggest one smaller fix. Do not invent files you were not shown.
popularity_note: A plain explanation first.

title: Short summary
prompt: Summarize [source] in five bullets for [reader]. Mark anything you cannot check.
popularity_note: Five bullets, with gaps marked.

title: One-page plan
prompt: Draft a one-page plan for [business] using only these facts: [facts]. Leave a blank where a fact is missing.
popularity_note: Uses only the facts you give.

title: Learn it in one sitting
prompt: Teach me [topic] for [use] in about 20 minutes, then give me one practice.
popularity_note: A short lesson and one practice.

title: Describe an image
prompt: Describe an image of [subject] for [use]. Say what must be in the frame and what to leave out.
popularity_note: A description you can hand to an image tool.

title: Short video script
prompt: Write a [length] video script about [topic] for [audience]. Draft only.
popularity_note: A script. Nothing is filmed or posted.

title: What to drop
prompt: From [week], list what to drop and the one thing to do first.
popularity_note: Cuts the week down to one first step.

title: Support reply
prompt: Draft a reply to [customer] about [issue]. Do not promise a refund or a date you were not given.
popularity_note: A draft reply. Nothing is sent.

title: Explain the numbers
prompt: Explain [numbers] in plain words for [reader]. Do not invent figures.
popularity_note: Plain words for numbers you already have.

title: Explain a clause
prompt: Explain [clause] in plain words. This is information, not legal advice. Do not tell me to sign.
popularity_note: Informational only. Not legal advice.

title: Interview questions
prompt: Write interview questions for a [role]. Ask about the work, not age, family, or health.
popularity_note: Questions about the work.

title: Listing from facts
prompt: Draft a listing for [property] using only these facts: [facts]. Do not invent rooms or prices.
popularity_note: A listing tied to the facts you give.

title: Explain a loan term
prompt: Explain [loan term] in plain words. This is not a loan offer and not a promise of approval.
popularity_note: An explanation, not an offer.

title: Explain a policy
prompt: Explain [policy] in plain words for [reader]. This is not a quote and not coverage advice.
popularity_note: An explanation, not a quote.

title: Explain a credit item
prompt: Explain [credit item] in plain words. This is information, not a promise to change a credit report.
popularity_note: Information only. No promise to repair credit.

title: A week of posts
prompt: Plan a week of posts for [creator] about [topic]. Drafts only. No income claims.
popularity_note: A week of drafts. Nothing is posted.

title: One step this week
prompt: Help me plan [goal] for this week. Ask one question, then give one next step.
popularity_note: One question, then one step.
